caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless waistcoat with a deep V-neckline and no collar, featuring a front opening that is fastened by six buttons. The waistcoat is depicted in shades of beige and light brown with a subtle sheen, and is decorated with a repeating pattern of floral motifs, including leaves and vines, in slightly darker brown and golden tones. There are two functional pockets on each side at the waist, and detailed stitching is visible around the edges and seams. The back and inner side of the waistcoat are shaded in muted grayish-brown hues, indicating a different fabric lining. The object is centrally positioned on an off-white or light tan background, with no other items present in the image. The artist’s signature, "C. W. Dawson", appears in small cursive handwriting near the lower right edge of the drawing.
title: Waistcoat
